method_note: REPRODUCIBLE audit of frozen machine issue #32's W44 forecast against final Master Monday and the READY 168-hour completed-week capture. The Day 5–7 two-branch description receives partial descriptive credit rather than directional credit. The previous 2–3-week and 21–30-day projections have not fully matured. Decision utility remains null without an execution outcome or supported rubric.
